events.title: Sounds and Postures
events.summary: A small polish patch. Nothing about how the game plays has changed. events.title: Visual Consequences
events.summary: This one is about consequences you can see. After every quarter, everyone with a stake in your firm now tells you what they think, and how close you came to losing it all. One rival starts taking things personally. And the office, and the people in it, start remembering the run.Years two and three are also a little tougher than before. events.title: Read all about it
events.summary: The city has newspapers now. There's a newsstand across the road from your office, and its papers are real papers you can sit and read: twelve pages each, with the markets up front and the rest of the city behind them. One lands on your desk every year, your firm turns up in it, and if you read closely, a few stories hint at what's coming.Read all about itA newsstand across the road. events.title: Leave Your Desk
events.summary: You can get up from your desk now and actually go somewhere. Take the lift down, walk out of the building and cross the road to Kingsgate Tower, where your rivals have their offices, and ride up to see how they work. The office itself has filled up with life: redrawn people, weather, a busier floor and a city that goes on past the window.Leave your deskTake the lift yourself. events.title: Variations and Animations
events.summary: No two runs of the demo play alike any more. Every run now deals its own three years instead of walking the same ones. Each quarter opens on its own headline with its own decisions. There are nearly twice as many crises that can hit you, twice as many private-equity deals that can be dealt, and five new research briefs.The terminal has come alive too. events.title: A Whole New Office
events.summary: This is the biggest update the demo has had. When you step back from the desk now, you're standing in a 3D office, and it's a whole floor of a building rather than a single room. You can walk to the window, sit down with your clients, and go down the corridor to the lifts and into the rooms off it.The building also keeps track of your run.
